NP Presspad 1.5.0 — Manuscript

A redesign of the whole app. Writing now looks like a page rather than a form: a serif typeface for your words, quieter screens around them, and one place that tells you whether your work has reached WordPress. Your posts, sites and settings carry over untouched.

**Companion plugin:** WordPress will offer a companion plugin update to 1.5.0. It contains no changes, but please accept it — until you do, the app will show a "Plugin version doesn't match" notice after each sync.

## A new look

- **Writing in a serif.** Posts, titles and excerpts are set in New York, Apple's reading typeface, with a comfortable line length. Prefer the old look? Switch to sans-serif in Settings › Appearance, under Writing typeface. Text is also a little larger by default.
- **Softer colours** in light and dark mode, with clear shapes for each post status (hollow for drafts, ringed for scheduled, solid for published) so they read without relying on colour.
- **A colour for each site.** Buttons, links and highlights take on the site's colour while you work on it, so you always know which site you're in. Pick one under Settings › Sites › Edit site.

## Finding your way

- **A sidebar** replaces the old toolbar. Switch sites from the top of it, jump between Home, Posts, Media and Templates, and open your recent scratchpads.
- **Sync status, always visible.** The bottom of the sidebar says whether everything is on WordPress, how many changes are waiting, or that you're offline and your work is safe on this Mac. Click it for the detail and a Sync now button.
- **Home** now tells you where things stand: posts to pick back up, changes not yet on WordPress, what's scheduled, what you've recently published, and how much you've written this week.
- **Posts** has status filters with counts, drafts grouped apart from published posts, featured images in the list, and a grid view. Press ⌘K to search.

## Writing

- **The title is part of the page.** Press Return in the title to start writing.
- **A slimmer toolbar** with a text-style menu (paragraph, headings, quote, code). Select text for quick bold, italic, heading and quote buttons. Undo and redo have left the toolbar — ⌘Z and ⇧⌘Z still work.
- **A redesigned post panel.** Publish and Schedule sit at the top with a plain-English status, and the excerpt is set in your writing typeface and grows as you type.
- **Focus mode** turns the page dark and dims every paragraph except the one you're in.
- **"Saved on this Mac"** in the title bar confirms every change is stored locally. History and Delete now live in the ⋯ menu.

## Shortcuts

- **⌘N** creates a new post. New Window has moved to **⇧⌘N**.
- **⌘K** searches your posts.

## Fixes

- **Duplicate to another site** in the ⋯ menu now works — it could not be reached before.
- **Excerpts no longer show `&hellip;`** and similar codes in place of "…", dashes and curly quotes. Existing excerpts are corrected the next time the post is pulled from WordPress.
- **The posts list updates straight away** when you change a post and leave it within a second — reverting to draft and going straight back showed the old status.
- **Dialogs fit the window.** Edit site and Add site are wider and no longer run off the top and bottom of a small window, and Add site explains how to create an application password.
